findings.text: The row assumes that D12 excludes the resolution premise of some "public query rules", but D12 excludes it only for surface rules of the D6 form (`Sql.check_send_<kind>`, `Sql.ifOk_send_<kind>` with `found`), the only such rule for a query, `Sql.check_send_select`, has no resolution premise (lines 352-353), and the query rules that do have one (`Run.send_unready`, `Run.send_mustFail`, `Run.query_mismatch`, `Run.query_overflow_calmTable`, `Script.outputOn_query`, `Script.outputIn_query`) are run and observation laws that D6, D7 and D12 do not name and that ADR 0027 D2 keeps with their premises, so an implementer cannot tell which rules to migrate from or whether to delete them. Fix: name in the row the query rules that slice 5 replaces and say what happens to each (deleted with a retention test per D8, or kept), or extend D12 "Surface" to define the excluded rules so that the row's reference holds.
